title: coord.py put needs no holder token, so any agent can overwrite the value of a key another agent has claimed
goal: (SP-rsmmwzr2 review G9) A put on a key under a live lease is refused (exit 1) unless it names the holder's --token, as gate writer answers; the holder's put with its --token and a put on a key with no live lease succeed at their revision

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
c('claim','K5','--ttl','60','--holder','a')
r=c('put','K5','--value','hijack','--revision','1')[0]
print('put on a leased key without its token exit',r);sys.exit(0 if r!=0 else 1)

import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,"c.db"))
def c(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py",*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60);return p.returncode,p.stdout
tok=json.loads(c("claim","K6","--ttl","60","--holder","a")[1])["token"]
other=c("put","K6","--value","x","--revision","1")[0]
own=c("put","K6","--value","y","--revision","1","--token",tok)[0]
free=c("put","K7","--value","z","--revision","0")[0]
print(dict(without_holder=other,holder=own,no_lease=free));sys.exit(0 if other==1 and own==0 and free==0 else 1)

gates.question: Who may put a value on a coord.py key while another agent's live lease holds it?
options: holder only: put on a key under a live lease is refused (exit 1) unless it names the holder's handle that claim printed; a key with no live lease takes a put from anyone at its revision
anyone: the lease guards the holder and not the value, and kb/_self/tools.md says so; the repro is rewritten
gates.recommendation: holder only: put on a key under a live lease is refused (exit 1) unless it names the holder's handle that claim printed; a key with no live lease takes a put from anyone at its revision
gates.answer: holder only: put on a key under a live lease is refused (exit 1) unless it names the holder's handle that claim printed; a key with no live lease takes a put from anyone at its revision

gates.question: Does coord.py put with --token on a key that holds no live lease succeed or exit 1?
options: exit 1: a token that does not hold the key is refused, as renew and release refuse it
succeed: the token is ignored when no lease holds the key
gates.recommendation: exit 1: a token that does not hold the key is refused, as renew and release refuse it
gates.answer: exit 1: a token that does not hold the key is refused, as renew and release refuse it
